purpose: Single machine-readable authority for current cross-repository state. It records only current heads with their tested CI runs, capability states, current limitations, freezes, open decisions and residual items. Historical values remain in Git history and in the owning repositories executable tests.

source_heads_at_record_time.workspace: omitted by design; the record cannot contain its own commit

workspace.evidence_scope: Exact head only: this hosted run is evidence for f21997f74e597880239b49c9b9f272b68893c3ef, the base head of the state correction. The record cannot contain its own commit.

ci.principle: A CI identifier is evidence only when paired with the exact head SHA it tested. Static gates, tests and deployment qualification are separate claims. Historical runs are retained as history, not as evidence for the current head.

freeze.m4_holdout_detail: No separate protected research holdout is defined beyond the historical EXP-M4-0001 synthetic holdout, which was consumed once post-selection. Do not relabel it as UNTOUCHED and do not reuse it.

EXP-M4-0001.historical_record: Retained as historical evidence; not erased, relabelled or reused. A positive synthetic screen is not alpha certification or permission to trade.

capabilities.ndc_version: v2 APPROVED 2026-11-23; enforced in Fieldbook producer and Nirnay consumer source, serializers, validators and tests; no standalone schema package is retained

current_limitations.detail: The concurrency test observes flock descriptors from threads; it does not spawn or qualify independent processes.
Protection is bounded to an owner-controlled directory and is not hardware-backed.
RecoveryJournalRoot::load is a library boundary that returns NOT-READY; no real durable adapters are integrated.
No D1 or beyond, power-loss, replication, nanosecond or horizontal-scale claim is made.
No registered venue adapter or live broker path exists.

open_owner_decisions: Provide written source rights for an exact operation and scope
Approve a versioned test-only fixture amendment
Define India venue and product coverage beyond the I1-I6 register
Ratify production resource profiles and numeric maxima

residual_items.effect: A required gate now recomputes and binds the declared digest over the declared research source set; drift fails closed. Experiments remain BLOCKED by the standing freeze; this gate proves source identity only.

status_vocabulary.PASS: check executed and assertion held in the recorded evidence
status_vocabulary.BLOCKED: required adapter or non-automatable deployment qualification is absent; fail closed, never a pass
status_vocabulary.EXTERNAL: verified by workspace commands outside the e2e script
